name: 通过 SAP Commerce Cloud 的 B2B 订单履行 (7MD)
name_en: B2B Order Fulfillment with SAP Commerce Cloud (7MD)
description_en_html:
Overview

Business customers expect the same high-level buying experience as private customers. At the same time, your organization wants to have the product data available in all channels in a consistent way without double maintenance.

The order created and stored in SAP Commerce Cloud is transferred to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for order fulfillment. The order status for the sales document is replicated from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition to SAP Commerce Cloud.

In addition, relevant master data, such as products (including classification, prices, and discount), stock level, business partners, and connected contact persons are replicated from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition to SAP Commerce Cloud.

Key Process Flow

  • Create or change business partner and contact in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and replicate to SAP Commerce Cloud
  • Maintain product master data in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and replicate to SAP Commerce Cloud
  • Maintain prices and discounts in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and replicate to SAP Commerce Cloud
  • Maintain product classification model in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and replicate to SAP Commerce Cloud
  • Replicate stock level from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition to SAP Commerce Cloud
  • Place an order in the Web shop and send it toSAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for order fulfillment
  • Replicate sales order status to SAP Commerce Cloud, including advanced shipping notification once order has been shipped
  • Optional: Order Simulate – prices, discounts, stock level and credit can be checked on the fly during check out
  • Place service order in the web shop and send it to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for order fulfillment
  • Customer can cancel undelivered service order in Web shop, if service is not wanted anymore
  • Complete the service order and release for billing in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
  • Generate invoice for orders and check corresponding invoice in the Web shop

Business Benefits

  • Focus your project on customer satisfaction by providing a first-class buying experience
  • Reduce cost and inconsistency with automated data replication and avoid double maintenance
  • Get reliable customer-specific business data as part of your B2B customers' buying experience
description_zh_html:
概览

业务客户希望获得与个人客户相同的高级购买体验。同时，您的组织希望以一致的方式在所有渠道中提供产品数据，而无需双重维护。

创建并存储在 SAP Commerce Cloud 中的订单将传输到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 以进行订单履行。销售凭证的订单状态从 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 复制到 SAP Commerce Cloud。

此外，相关主数据（例如产品（包括分类、价格和折扣）、库存水平、业务伙伴和相关联系人将从 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 复制到 SAP Commerce Cloud。

关键流程流

  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中创建或更改业务伙伴和联系人并复制到 SAP Commerce Cloud
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中维护产品主数据并复制到 SAP Commerce Cloud
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中维护价格和折扣并复制到 SAP Commerce Cloud
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中维护产品分类模型并复制到 SAP Commerce Cloud
  • 将库存水平从 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 复制到 SAP Commerce Cloud
  • 在网上商店下订单并将其发送至 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 以履行订单
  • 将销售订单状态复制到 SAP Commerce Cloud，包括订单装运后的提前装运通知
  • 可选：订单模拟 - 可在检出期间即时检查价格、折扣、库存水平和贷项
  • 在网上商店下服务订单并将其发送到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 进行订单履行
  • 如果不再需要服务，客户可以在网上商店中取消未交付的服务订单
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中完成服务订单并审批以供开票
  • 生成订单发票，并检查网上商店中的相应发票

业务优势

  • 通过提供一流的购买体验，将您的项目专注于客户满意度
  • 通过自动数据复制降低成本和不一致，避免重复维护
  • 作为 B2B 客户购买体验的一部分，获取可靠的客户特定业务数据
